item.title: Site Launch!
item.description:
Finally got this personal website up and running! Thank you Olivier Tremblay for telling me to use Hugo. Should have listened to you earlier. It is so easy and lightning fast.

This Fall is gonna fly by with the start of my Master’s degree. I’ll be adding a ton more content in the Projects section when I get a chance. Also, once I get some more academic papers completed I will create a special section dedicated to them as well.

Time to get to get to work.
